bridge_matching: repeat-specific realized edges; community-pair x weight-bin x degree-sum-bin with audited fixed relaxation tiers
assortative_matching: common-support trimming; same community hard constraint; continuous nearest match on internal degree and baseline abundance plus fixed 0.25 broad-role penalty; without replacement; no cross-community/global fallback
assortative_priority: pressure sensitivity jointly weighted by within-community structural contribution; no pressure-specific post-hoc tuning
node_abundance_policy: deleted node abundance set to zero; remaining abundance renormalized
abundance_activity_threshold: >0 after community-level redistribution and ASV proportional scaling
primary_effect: trapezoidal AUC of targeted loss minus matched-control loss over x=0..1
